[1/3] Plan per-property prefab override detection, editor exposure, and per-field revert/apply actions

impact_assessment.why: Instances can diverge from their prefab templates, but the editor exposes only whole-instance revert/apply, so AI and human users cannot see or resolve individual overrides.
impact_assessment.benefits: A deterministic prefab_overrides report lists template/instance field differences, and revert_prefab_override/apply_prefab_override resolve one field with undo for scene edits and library-safe prefab writes for applies.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: editor schema 23 and two new actions; dependency: none; concurrency: existing editor lock; state: field mapping across roots/children, nested group boundaries, component presence, and atomic library writes.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Map template and instance trees structurally, skip nested boundaries, compare stable field values, validate the field against the live report, clone templates for applies, and add override/revert/apply/undo/library tests.

[1/3] Plan deterministic component lifecycle hooks with editor schema/play-state exposure and tests

impact_assessment.why: Authored components are inert data; there is no start/update/stop lifecycle, so behaviors cannot run deterministically in editor play mode.
impact_assessment.benefits: A core ComponentRuntime runs start/update/stop in deterministic scene/type order, editor component schemas advertise hooks, play mode reports started/frame state, and authored behaviors execute without changing the five-operation game contract.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: editor schema 24 and a new core module; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: editor lock; state: hook order, one start/stop, frame counting, removal/adding during play, and authored-scene restore.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use DFS node order plus sorted component types, track started identities, reverse-order stop, validate dt, restore the play snapshot on stop, and add order/exposure/play regressions.

[1/3] Plan additive scene groups with persisted metadata, add/unload/save actions, editor inventory and tests

impact_assessment.why: The editor edits one scene at a time; Unity/Unreal-style additive authoring needs named scene groups that can be loaded, unloaded and saved independently.
impact_assessment.benefits: A .kscene can be added as a named group, saved back in place and unloaded with undo, while scene-group metadata survives snapshots and /api/editor exposes the inventory.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: scene snapshot schema 4 and editor schema 25; dependency: none; concurrency: existing editor lock; state: ID collisions, nested groups, camera/environment ownership, prefab links inside groups and save atomicity.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Persist group metadata on container nodes, clone scene content with links, rename only colliding IDs, save through a temporary Scene, expose group IDs, and test add/save/unload/persistence/undo.

[1/3] Plan multi-selection sets, batch transform/toggle/delete, console multi-select and group gizmo

impact_assessment.why: The editor supports only one selected node; Unity/Unreal-style batch authoring needs selection sets and batch actions.
impact_assessment.benefits: select_many builds ordered selection sets, transform_selection/toggle_selection_visible/delete_selection edit all selected nodes in one undo, the console supports multi-select, and the viewport highlights the set with a centroid translate gizmo.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: editor schema 26 and selection document shape; dependency: none; concurrency: editor lock; state: primary selection compatibility, parent/child selection deduplication, prefab group deletion, gizmo preview of shared subtrees, undo.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep selected_id as a single-selection-compatible primary, filter top-level selected roots for batch transform, dedupe groups for delete, preview only union subtrees, and add selection/batch/gizmo/undo tests.

[1/3] Plan centroid group rotate and uniform scale for multi-selection

impact_assessment.why: Multi-selection only translated; rotating or scaling several nodes around a shared center required per-node edits.
impact_assessment.benefits: A pivot rotation or uniform scale preview and one transform_selection action with undo for top-level selected nodes.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: editor schema 27; dependency: none; concurrency: existing editor lock; state: parent-relative local decomposition, non-uniform parent scales, selected descendant deduplication.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Filter top-level selected roots, compose parent-world rotation, convert world positions through the parent inverse, preview with pivot matrices, and add rotation/scale/undo tests.

[1/3] Plan viewport box selection with replace/add/toggle modifiers and existing selection/gizmo integration

impact_assessment.why: The viewport can only click-select one node at a time; Unity/Unreal-style multi-selection needs marquee selection over projected bounds.
impact_assessment.benefits: A box-select mode draws a rectangle and selects intersecting nodes with replace/add/toggle modifiers, reusing select_many, highlighting and the batch centroid gizmo.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no REST change, UI-only; dependency: none; concurrency: pointer arbitration with camera orbit, gizmo drags and pointer capture; state: projected AABB edge cases and overlay cleanup.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add explicit box-select mode, prioritize gizmo hits, project all eight bounds corners, cancel cleanly on pointercancel, and add static UI/viewer regression checks.
